task: Desktop release runbook and one-command package pipeline

resource_risks.description: The desktop pipeline launches multiple child processes for pnpm, Rust, Tauri, codesign, and hdiutil.
resource_risks.mitigation: The pipeline uses spawnSync with inherited stdio, checks exit status after each process, and exits immediately on failure instead of leaving background work.

resource_risks.description: Internal packaging creates Tauri release artifacts under src-tauri/target.
resource_risks.mitigation: Artifacts remain in the Tauri target directory and are not staged as durable repository knowledge; validation records list their paths without tracking generated bundles.

lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: Each spawnSync child process exits before the next step begins; no detached/background option is used.
evidence: corepack pnpm run desktop:package:internal completed with generated .app/DMG and artifact verification

measurement_checks.metric: Generated app bundles are not staged as tracked repository changes.
measurement_checks.threshold: Only source/docs/history/snapshot files appear as changed; target bundle artifacts stay untracked or ignored.

notes: No server, watcher, browser automation, or detached long-running process was started by the final pipeline.
